component.name: Debos - Toolbox
component.summary: All-in-one toolbox for Debian Stable, Testing and Sid

description.p: Debos - Toolbox keeps a Debian desktop healthy and lets you customize it from one place.

ul.li: Dashboard with health score and smart recommendations
System cleaner: package cache, old kernels, logs, thumbnails, browser caches
Updates and switching between Debian Stable, Testing and Sid
Repository Doctor for duplicate entries and missing or expired GPG keys, plus extrepo third-party repositories
Software center with Debian packages, vendor repositories and Flathub
Desktop environments, window managers and login managers packaged in Debian
Kernels: XanMod, Liquorix, Linux-libre, backports and builds from kernel.org
Hardware detection with driver and firmware recommendations
Desktop tweaks, startup applications, default applications and templates

description.p: Rebuilt from scratch with GTK 4: new design, embedded console, recommendations, Repository Doctor, extrepo, kernel.org builds as Debian packages, removal of manually installed kernels, sysfs driver detection and desktop tweaks.
